response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded, and DevOps, which makes him substantially overqualified for a junior/mid-level entry role. While his technical skillset (TypeScript, Node.js, React, REST, SQL) covers the core requirements, the seniority mismatch raises concerns about role fit, retention, and salary expectations, and PostgreSQL/Nest.js are not explicitly evidenced in his experience.
strengths: Deep, broad fullstack experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and React across many production systems
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, mentoring, workshops) indicating high code quality standards
Berlin-based, so on-site presence requirement is feasible
concerns: Significant overqualification for a junior/mid entry-level IC role, risking quick disengagement or turnover
No explicit PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience (mostly MongoDB/MySQL/SQL, AWS CDK/GraphQL stack)
No direct exposure to renewable energy, construction, or CRM/document integration domain
